1.title: In Dropping Reflecting Pool Case, Pirro Draws Trump’s Wrath
1.summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney in Washington, blamed shoddy construction, contradicting President Trump’s pet theory. Mr. Trump said he disagreed “100%” with her.

2.title: Trump Calls for $1.8 Billion Fund Over Blanche Attorney General Fight
2.summary: The president vowed to push for the payout fund if Senate Republicans fail to confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general, reigniting a dispute over the settlement.

3.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
3.summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

4.title: Improvised Bomb Kills 3 at an Upscale Moscow Restaurant
4.summary: Among the victims of the explosion, which also injured 21 people, were a security guard and a woman who the authorities say had arrived with the suspicious package.

5.title: Spain Installs Floating Barrier in Ceuta After Influx of Migrants
5.summary: Most of those who came to the territory, a Spanish exclave in Africa, have returned across the border to Morocco. At least 67 people died trying to enter, the authorities said.

6.title: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say
6.summary: Security officials said a woman tried to enter the restaurant with explosives but was stopped by a security guard.
